end.summary:
Ira showed understanding of reading and plotting position-time graphs, including that slope gives velocity.
They practised reading velocity-time graphs, including slope as acceleration and area as distance; this still needs checking in a new situation.
They calculated acceleration and distance from a triangular velocity-time graph using slope and area.
They connected graph slope to cycling pace and cricket run rate.
end.parentNote: Asha practised position-time and velocity-time graphs with Ira. Ira used slope to find velocity or acceleration and area under a velocity-time graph to find distance, including a triangular graph. Position-time reading was shown on a new-situation question; velocity-time slope still needs more checking next time. At home, ask Ira to explain what the slope and area mean on one fresh velocity-time graph.
